name: South Park Commons
identity_check: Confirmed as South Park Commons (southparkcommons.com), the San Francisco founder community started in 2016 around Ruchi Sanghvi's dining table, which runs a Member Residency, a $1M Founder Fellowship and a venture fund writing $1M-$10M first checks; offices in San Francisco (380 Brannan St), New York and Bengaluru (SPC India). Not South Park Ventures or any other 'South Park' fund.
